children: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said Monday in a post on X that she had not ruled out issuing government bonds to help finance the overall budget, while reiterating that she would not rely on special deficit-financing bonds to cover the shortfall caused by a temporary sales tax cut. According to Sina Finance, the post was intended to clarify her remarks in parliament.

title: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi Has Not Ruled Out Issuing Bonds to Finance Budget
